detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to the world of Now THAT'S a Big Dragon!    

Your home kingdom is in danger, and it's up to you to recruit and expand an ever-growing band of brave warriors, wizards, and all sorts of adventurers who relentlessly attack a single, gigantic dragon. The game is a numbers-driven idle experience: buy more troops, upgrade their power, automate your economy, and click the dragon yourself for bonus damage.

This game expands on the idle incremental genre while keeping its most important feature: NUMBERS... GOING... UP! ⬆️ ⬆️ ⬆️ ⬆️ ⬆️

In this game you'll find:

  • Upgrades: Plenty of options to boost your actions and automation.

  • Multiple characters: Automation now has a face and different skills.

  • Multiple currencies/resources: Grow your gold, wood, iron and food.

  • Synergy: Different upgrades or characters affect the progress or power of other game elements.

  • An enemy that fights back: Protect yourself from the dragon's roar, and fire attacks.

  • It has an ending: Feel the relief of saving your kingdom and ending the crisis.

  • It has a new beginning: Revisit the game with new modifiers.

It’s time for you to pack your gear and join the adventure!
